messages.subject: Problems with spin and rbokeh
parts:
(Sorry for the typo on the Subject filed in previous message; could not find the way to edit it)

1. If I use the following simple R code for spin() 
library(rbokeh) 
p <- figure() %>% 
    ly_points(Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width, data = iris, 
              color = Species, glyph = Species, 
              hover = list(Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width)) 
p 

saved as test_rbokeh_log.R 
and use spin: 
spin("test_rbokeh_log.R") 

I get a file "test_rbokeh_log.html" with no graphic. 

If I use: 
spin("test_rbokeh_log.R",knit=FALSE) 
then I get a file "test_rbokeh_log.Rmd" 
with which I can create a correct html by using the button "Preview HTML" 
within RStudio. 

2. More important: if I use my own data, i.e. 
library(rbokeh) 
p <- figure() %>% 
    ly_points(x,y, data = mydf, 
              color = z, glyph = z, 
              hover = list(x, y)) 
p 

saved as test2_rbokeh_log.R 
where 
mydf <- data.frame(x=rnorm(10,2),y=rnorm(20,4), 
                   z=as.character(c(rep(1,5),rep(2,5)))) 
has been previously defined outside the script (i.e., on the console) 
and use spin: 
spin("test_rbokeh_log.R",knit=FALSE) 
then I also get a file "test2_rbokeh_log.Rmd" 
but get an error when using the button "Preview HTML" 
within RStudio: 

processing file: test2_rbokeh_log.Rmd 

Quitting from lines 3-9 (test2_rbokeh_log.Rmd) 
Error in ly_points(., x, y, data = mydf, color = z, glyph = z, hover = 
list(x,  : 
  object 'mydf' not found 
Calls: <Anonymous> ... _fseq -> freduce -> withVisible -> <Anonymous> 
-> ly_points 
Execution halted 

The error does not come up if df is defined within the script 
test2_rbokeh_log.R itself 

Thanks for any clarification on this problem 

Agus
